sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the metre unit, $this projection/grouping, bidirectional pointwise coverage, intended-waterline maximum as the expected direction, and tolerance scaled from that expected result. Repair the bounded aggregation by eliminating the redundant second grouped SELECT and use one bounded grouped aggregation that emits every longitudinal position from either waterline, enforces a counterpart on both sides, and compares UIWL coordinates with the intended-waterline maximum. Replace ABS(?expected), which is outside the permitted DIRECT_STATIC calculation operators, with an allowed simple piecewise absolute-value expression (or equivalent permitted formulation).
